name: What permits are required for double-pane window replacement in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for double-pane window replacement in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Daly City, minor window replacements that do not alter the size or framing of existing openings typically do not require a separate building permit. However, if the replacement involves changing the size of the window opening, altering the structural framing, or if you are doing a full remodel, a permit would likely be necessary. It is always recommended to consult with your contractor, who can verify current local regulations with the Daly City Building Division to ensure full compliance before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Daly City, permits are usually not needed for same-size window replacements. Changes to openings or framing typically require one.
